evidence.observation: Temperature tracked the ramp setpoint to within about 0.5 °C. After a 10 °C overshoot at the start of growth it has held at 749.4–749.8 °C against a 750 °C setpoint.
Heater power rose smoothly from 47% to 83% during the ramp, then settled at 45–46% during the hold, which fits a heater holding temperature.
Argon flow has stayed within 1 sccm of setpoint throughout: 200 sccm during purge, 100 sccm from the ramp on.
Controller status has read 'running' throughout, and the readings keep changing, so the status does not look stale.

args.missing_evidence: No pressure gauge or exhaust O₂ sensor is installed, so a seal leak or exhaust blockage would not show up in this data. No normal-run reference values were supplied, so heater power can't be checked against a baseline. Characterization of the sample after the run is needed before the recipe can be judged.
